facts.fact: The VNG International-backed ULGE project piloted e-billing and e-payment for property and land lease in Yirgalem city, under an April 2022 agreement with the Sidama Regional State and the municipality; the city then collected only 3 per cent of its potential tax.
The project page says property and land lease processes in Yirgalem were overhauled with e-billing and e-payment after a comprehensive update of property assessments.
